# Welcome to CDK TypeScript project generated by FastCDK

This is a blank project for CDK development with TypeScript.

The `cdk.json` file tells the CDK Toolkit how to execute your app.

## Useful commands

* `npm run build`   compile typescript to js
* `npm run watch`   watch for changes and compile
* `npm run test`    perform the jest unit tests
* `npx cdk deploy`  deploy this stack to your default AWS account/region
* `npx cdk diff`    compare deployed stack with current state
* `npx cdk synth`   emits the synthesized CloudFormation template

* Commands for listing changes of resources:
  * `cdk diff -c config=dev --profile markovic`
  * `cdk diff -c config=prod --profile markovic`

* Commands for deployment of resources:
  * `cdk deploy -c config=dev --profile markovic`
  * `cdk deploy -c config=prod --profile markovic`

* Login to docker `aws ecr get-login-password --region eu-west-1 --profile markovic | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 397130095288.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com`
* Deploy docker image of scraping service: `docker build --tag 397130095288.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/dev/fast-cdk-example-backend:latest -f ./build-scripts/Dockerfile --build-arg ENV_NAME=dev --no-cache ./`
* Push docker image to ECR: `docker push 397130095288.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/dev/fast-cdk-example-backend:latest`
